claims.says: On every token list and step budget, the modelled expression parser never reaches one of its panic sites (unwrap, child access, unreachable), and every tree it returns is well formed.
Given an expression parser that never panics, the modelled top-level Cypher parser (index commands, every clause, end of input) never panics on any input or step budget.
Given the primary-expression contract on opening brackets, every input the modelled parser accepts is derivable in the transcribed Cypher grammar plus FalkorDB's listed extensions, with that tree.
When the model of connected_components finishes, its components share no node, hold only graph nodes or relationship endpoints, and cover every node whose id is not also a relationship or path id.
